reasonableness.draft_prompt: Clay fairytale winter farm, farmer holding lamb, soft clay style from reference.
reasonableness.revised_prompt: Brand-new winter farm snowfield scene locking ONLY the fairy-garden polymer-clay fairytale medium from the style reference: smooth matte soft-plastic surfaces, doughy rounded edges, soft high-key studio light with gentle AO, shallow bokeh, candy-saturated cheerful palette translated to winter. Vertical 9:16. Slightly high three-quarter medium shot: chubby 2.5-head Q-farmer stands center-low cradling a round clay baby lamb against the chest with both mittens; clear mitten-to-fleece contact; lamb limbs are short clay tubes (sheep joints, not human elbows). Farmer and lamb MUST have large colored irises (warm brown or soft blue) with visible white crescent sclera and bright specular highlight on each eye—absolutely no solid black-dot pupils. Behind: one soft rounded clay barn with snow-capped roof and a few clay fence posts on smooth white clay snow with shallow footprints; only one foreground prop (single hay bundle). Palette: cream snow #FFF8E1 ~70%, warm wood/barn berry ~20%, pink scarf/mittens #F48FB1 ~10%. Hard bans: no mole, no petal flower-house, no creek/pond, no mushroom table, no giant tropical leaves, no vine bridge, no copying the reference garden left-right layout. Snow reads as smooth white clay, not crystalline ice. Commercial casual fairy-tale mobile key-art finish, clean silhouette.
